settings.title: The federal annual return is separate

settings.editor: A federal Corporations Canada annual return costs $12.00 and is due within 60 days of your anniversary. It is a government fee and HST does not apply to it.
Our credentials are never shared and no part of your file is sent offshore.
One price, stated in full before you pay
$300.00 per tax year, plus $39.00 HST, so $339.00 in total per tax year. Each tax year is a separate return and carries the same fee.

settings.title: If your corporation is not nil

settings.editor:
This service is for a corporation with no activity in the tax year. A corporation with investment income, rental income, or dividends paid or received is not nil.

If your corporation is not nil, we move your file to gondaliyacpa.ca at $350.00 including HST per tax year and tell you before any further charge.
